title: Health and the doctor
focus: 症状 过敏 发炎 处方 挂号 体检 疫苗 副作用 康复 手术 慢性病 血压 诊断 急诊 住院 失眠 抑郁 免疫力 复查 医保
body:
# Health and the doctor

You can say 我头疼 and 我感冒了. A real doctor's visit needs more: describing symptoms, understanding a diagnosis, asking about side effects, and getting through a Chinese hospital, where you register (挂号) before you see anyone.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 症状 | zhèngzhuàng | symptom |
| 过敏 | guòmǐn | to be allergic / allergy |
| 发炎 | fāyán | to become inflamed (a wound, throat) |
| 处方 | chǔfāng | prescription (written by a doctor) |
| 挂号 | guàhào | to register / get a queue number (at a hospital) |
| 体检 | tǐjiǎn | medical checkup / physical exam |
| 疫苗 | yìmiáo | vaccine |
| 副作用 | fùzuòyòng | side effect |
| 康复 | kāngfù | to make a full recovery (formal, also wishes) |
| 恢复 | huīfù | to recover / get back to normal (gradually) |
| 手术 | shǒushù | surgery / operation |
| 慢性病 | mànxìngbìng | chronic illness |
| 血压 | xuèyā | blood pressure |
| 诊断 | zhěnduàn | to diagnose / diagnosis |
| 急诊 | jízhěn | emergency department / ER |
| 住院 | zhùyuàn | to be hospitalized / stay in hospital |
| 失眠 | shīmián | insomnia / can't sleep |
| 抑郁 | yìyù | depressed (mood) / depression |
| 免疫力 | miǎnyìlì | immunity / immune system |
| 复查 | fùchá | follow-up appointment / to go back for a recheck |
| 医保 | yībǎo | public medical insurance (China) |
| 感染 | gǎnrǎn | to get infected / infection |
| 传染 | chuánrǎn | contagious / to spread (disease, person to person) |
| 化验 | huàyàn | lab test (blood, urine) |
| 肠胃 | chángwèi | stomach and digestion / digestive system |
| 心理医生 | xīnlǐ yīshēng | therapist / psychologist |

## Which word?

- **康复 vs 恢复.** 恢复 is the process of getting better, and works for anything (恢复正常). 康复 is full recovery from illness and is formal: 祝你早日康复.
- **感染 vs 发炎 vs 传染.** 感染 is germs getting in. 发炎 is the swelling and redness that follows. 传染 is spreading from person to person.
- **诊断 vs 检查 vs 化验.** 检查 is any exam. 化验 is a lab test of blood or urine. 诊断 is the doctor's conclusion.
- **体检 vs 复查.** 体检 is a routine checkup when you are well. 复查 is going back after treatment to check on a known problem.
- **挂号 vs 急诊.** At a Chinese hospital you 挂号 to see a regular department; for emergencies you 挂急诊 instead.

## Examples

- 医生,我咳嗽一个星期了,还有点发烧。 yīshēng, wǒ késou yí ge xīngqī le, hái yǒudiǎn fāshāo: Doctor, I've had a cough for a week and a slight fever
- 你对什么药过敏吗? nǐ duì shénme yào guòmǐn ma: Are you allergic to any medicines?
- 嗓子发炎了,医生给我开了点消炎药。 sǎngzi fāyán le, yīshēng gěi wǒ kāi le diǎn xiāoyányào: My throat is inflamed and the doctor gave me anti-inflammatories
- 这个药副作用很大,吃了老犯困。 zhège yào fùzuòyòng hěn dà, chī le lǎo fànkùn: This medicine has strong side effects, it makes me drowsy
- 体检发现我血压有点高。 tǐjiǎn fāxiàn wǒ xuèyā yǒudiǎn gāo: The checkup found my blood pressure is a bit high
- 手术很成功,不过要住院观察几天。 shǒushù hěn chénggōng, búguò yào zhùyuàn guānchá jǐ tiān: The surgery went well, but he has to stay in a few days for observation
- 老人免疫力差,容易被传染。 lǎorén miǎnyìlì chà, róngyì bèi chuánrǎn: Old people have weak immunity and catch things easily
- 最近工作压力大,我一直失眠。 zuìjìn gōngzuò yālì dà, wǒ yìzhí shīmián: Work has been stressful and I can't sleep
- 这次诊断结果还要等化验报告。 zhè cì zhěnduàn jiéguǒ hái yào děng huàyàn bàogào: The diagnosis has to wait for the lab report

cards.Example: 你还有别的症状吗? nǐ hái yǒu bié de zhèngzhuàng ma: Do you have any other symptoms?
我对青霉素过敏。 wǒ duì qīngméisù guòmǐn: I'm allergic to penicillin
cards.Notes: Pattern: 对…过敏 = allergic to …

cards.Example: 伤口发炎了。 shāngkǒu fāyán le: The wound is inflamed
cards.Notes: 嗓子发炎 = sore, inflamed throat.

cards.Example: 这个药要有处方才能买。 zhège yào yào yǒu chǔfāng cái néng mǎi: You need a prescription to buy this medicine
cards.Notes: 处方药 = prescription drug. Spoken: 医生给我开了药.

cards.English: to register / get a queue number (at a hospital)
cards.Example: 你先去挂个号。 nǐ xiān qù guà ge hào: Go and register first
cards.Notes: Separable: 挂个号, 挂急诊. Chinese hospitals require this before seeing a doctor.

cards.Example: 公司每年安排一次体检。 gōngsī měi nián ānpái yí cì tǐjiǎn: The company arranges a checkup every year
你打疫苗了吗? nǐ dǎ yìmiáo le ma: Have you had the vaccine?
cards.Notes: 打疫苗 = get vaccinated.

cards.Example: 这个药有什么副作用吗? zhège yào yǒu shénme fùzuòyòng ma: Does this medicine have any side effects?

cards.English: to make a full recovery (formal, also wishes)
cards.Example: 祝你早日康复! zhù nǐ zǎorì kāngfù: Wishing you a speedy recovery!
cards.Notes: 康复 is formal and final; 恢复 is the ongoing process.

cards.English: to recover / get back to normal (gradually)
cards.Example: 他手术后恢复得很好。 tā shǒushù hòu huīfù de hěn hǎo: He's recovering well after the operation
cards.Notes: Also for non-medical things: 恢复正常 = back to normal.

cards.Example: 我爸下周要做手术。 wǒ bà xià zhōu yào zuò shǒushù: My dad is having surgery next week
cards.Notes: 做手术 = have (or perform) surgery.

cards.Example: 高血压是一种慢性病。 gāoxuèyā shì yì zhǒng mànxìngbìng: High blood pressure is a chronic illness
cards.Notes: Opposite: 急性 (acute), as in 急性肠胃炎.

cards.Example: 我帮你量一下血压。 wǒ bāng nǐ liáng yíxià xuèyā: Let me take your blood pressure
cards.Notes: 血 is xuè in compounds; xiě on its own in speech (流血了 liú xiě le).

cards.Example: 医生诊断是肺炎。 yīshēng zhěnduàn shì fèiyán: The doctor diagnosed pneumonia
他半夜被送去急诊了。 tā bànyè bèi sòng qù jízhěn le: He was taken to the ER in the middle of the night
cards.Notes: 看急诊 / 挂急诊 = go to the ER.

cards.English: to be hospitalized / stay in hospital
cards.Example: 奶奶住院一个星期了。 nǎinai zhùyuàn yí ge xīngqī le: Grandma has been in hospital for a week
cards.Notes: 出院 = be discharged.

cards.Example: 我最近老失眠。 wǒ zuìjìn lǎo shīmián: I keep having trouble sleeping lately
他压力太大,有点抑郁。 tā yālì tài dà, yǒudiǎn yìyù: He's under too much pressure and a bit depressed
cards.Notes: 抑郁症 = clinical depression; 焦虑 = anxious.

cards.Example: 多运动可以提高免疫力。 duō yùndòng kěyǐ tígāo miǎnyìlì: Exercise boosts your immunity
cards.Notes: 提高 / 增强免疫力 = boost immunity.

cards.English: follow-up appointment / to go back for a recheck
cards.Example: 医生让我一个月后来复查。 yīshēng ràng wǒ yí ge yuè hòu lái fùchá: The doctor told me to come back in a month for a follow-up
cards.Notes: 复诊 is similar: a return visit to the doctor.

cards.Example: 这个药医保能报吗? zhège yào yībǎo néng bào ma: Does public insurance cover this medicine?
cards.Notes: Short for 医疗保险. 报 here = reimburse.

cards.Example: 别用手摸伤口,容易感染。 bié yòng shǒu mō shāngkǒu, róngyì gǎnrǎn: Don't touch the wound, it can get infected
cards.Notes: 感染 = germs get in; 发炎 = inflammation (often the result).

cards.English: contagious / to spread (disease, person to person)
cards.Example: 这个病会传染吗? zhège bìng huì chuánrǎn ma: Is this illness contagious?
cards.Notes: 传染给 = pass it on to someone.

cards.Example: 先去抽血化验一下。 xiān qù chōuxiě huàyàn yíxià: First go and get a blood test
cards.Notes: 化验单 = lab results sheet.

cards.Example: 我肠胃不太好。 wǒ chángwèi bú tài hǎo: I have a sensitive stomach
cards.Notes: 肠胃炎 = gastroenteritis.

cards.Example: 你可以考虑去看看心理医生。 nǐ kěyǐ kǎolǜ qù kànkan xīnlǐ yīshēng: You might consider seeing a therapist
cards.Notes: 心理咨询 = counseling.

cards.English: Do I need to take this on an empty stomach?
cards.Pinyin: zhège yào yào kōngfù chī ma
cards.Notes: 饭后吃 = take after meals.

cards.English: When will the results be ready?
cards.Notes: 出结果 = results come out.
